title: Welspun Corp hits record on ₹4,000 cr US order

timeline.title: Welspun Corp hits record on ₹4,000 cr US order
timeline.line: US arm wins its largest-ever pipe order (~$412.5 mn); stock up 5% to a record ₹2,837.50
more: Welspun Tubular LLC will supply high-frequency induction welded (HFIW) pipes
The order is worth about $412.5 mn, or ₹4,000 cr
The stock is up about four-fold from its February low

src.title: Business Standard — Welspun Corp jumps 5% as US arm wins ₹4,000 cr order
